disposition_reason: Tables 1 and 2 print mean ± SD Cd, Co, Cr, Mo, Ni, Pb and Se (µg/g) in 12 dried fruits and 26 raw, roasted or coated nuts, seeds and grain snacks bought in Konya, Turkey.

study.design: Market survey of dried fruits, nuts and seeds
study.market: a market in Konya Province, Turkey
study.method: Microwave digestion (5 mL HNO3 + 2 mL H2O2, 210 °C) of 0.2 g; ICP-OES (Varian Vista)
study.qa: One blank and one NIST CRM (1547a wheat flour, 8346 wheat flour, 1547 peach leaves) per microwave set; recoveries not reported
